svg.text: PaidHR GTM System: outbound, end to end
svg.textArea: Design v0.1 from context/docs/gtm-system.md. Row 1 reads left to right, row 2 right to left, row 3 left to right.
svg.text: 2 Pick the people and write the message

rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
ICP, personas, signal matrix, facts.md, workflow spec

1B Buying signals
• HR and payroll hiring
• Frontline volume hiring
• New HR or Finance leader
• Fresh funding
• Dec to Jan: annual returns

1C Find companies
Employer name to domain and LinkedIn page

1E Enrich
• Headcount, HQ, industry
• States in job posts
• Frontline share
• HR title present
• Funding, rival tool

2A Find people
• Up to 2 per account
• HR lead and CEO
• Finance lead at 100+
• S6: CEO only

2B Find and verify email
Waterfall of providers, then verify

2D Personalise
Signal and angle into approved templates; claims only from facts.md

2F Human approval
Rule 4: nothing sends without a yes

3A Send the sequence
3 emails over about 10 days, plus LinkedIn (tool not chosen)

3B Sort replies
AI tags the intent; low confidence goes to a human
Wait for a new signal, back to 1B

3G Weekly review
Meeting rate by signal, segment and angle; keep, change angle or kill
Weekly loop: results update the Context OS
